name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Beaded ID Holder with Lanyard And Acrylic Charm
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality acrylic, durable lanyard cord, and metal hardware, offering a stylish, lightweight, and practical everyday accessory.
    - Features a 1-layer acrylic main piece with 3mm thickness, creating a sturdy and eye-catching personalized ID holder.
    - Includes 2 matching 1-layer acrylic charms with a layered acrylic effect and a total thickness of 9mm.
    - Comes with a soft cotton tassel, metal keyring, clasp, and decorative beaded accessory for a fun and coordinated finish.
    - Available in 16 accessory set options, including a variety of bead shapes, tassel color combinations, and matching keyring accessories.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Lanyard length: 42.3 cm ~ 16.65 in
    - Main acrylic piece: 2.5 x 2.5 in ~ 6.35 x 6.35 cm
    - Acrylic charm size: 1 x 1 in ~ 2.54 x 2.54 cm
    - Acrylic charm layer thickness: 3mm each layer
    - Acrylic charm total thickness: 9mm
    - Cotton tassel with keyring/clasp length: 9 cm ~ 3.54 in
    📌 Note:  The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vivid colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Supports double-sided printing for the main acrylic piece and the acrylic charm.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized ID holder accessory and a decorative lanyard set.
    - Designed to hold ID badges, name tags, keys, or lightweight daily essentials conveniently.
    - Suitable for schools, offices, classrooms, hospitals, events, and everyday work environments.
    - Lightweight and comfortable for daily wear around the neck or attached to personal items.
    - Perfect for adding a fun, colorful, and personalized touch to routine work or school accessories.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for teachers, students, coworkers, nurses, office staff, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for back-to-school gifts, teacher appreciation, birthdays, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for school staff, classroom helpers, office workers, and anyone who loves personalized accessories.
    - A thoughtful gift for daily-use essentials that combine style and practicality.
    - Great for appreciation gifts, work accessories, and personalized keepsakes.
    - Adds a fun, cheerful, and personal touch to everyday life 🎁

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
